_about: VS-30, the boss phase change (docs/slice/boss_design.md 'Transition', docs/maps/kasp_arena.md step 5), Gameplay Programmer. Starting guesses; the Combat Designer and Ross tune by playing. All times in seconds. `markers` are the names of Node3D / Marker3D nodes the arena scene must have (anywhere under the room); `ring_road` is a node whose Node3D children, in order, are the loader's waypoints (or markers ring_road_1, ring_road_2 ...). If a marker is missing the step still runs from sensible fallbacks. Red cannot be hurt from the start of kasp_escape to the end of the dock.
